topic: HYDRAA plans *Rs 75 crore* Fox Sagar lak
hook: A *Rs 75 crore* plan to revive Fox Sagar lake.
hook_b: A *Rs 75 crore* plan to revive Fox Sagar lake.
tldr: HYDRAA plans a Rs 75 crore makeover of the historic Fox Sagar lake.

beats.what: INDToday and New Indian Express report HYDRAA's plan to revamp historic Fox Sagar, with a Rs 75 crore price tag.
beats.why: HYDRAA has been reclaiming lakes and nalas; a makeover shifts the focus to restoring one.
beats.care: Lakes decide how badly your area floods and whether you get a park or a fence.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: INDToday puts the Fox Sagar makeover at Rs 75 crore. Timeline and design details were not in the headlines.

cards.q: Rs 75 crore on one lake. What should a lake makeover do first?
opts: Open it up as a public park

sources.name: INDToday
